alter table public.classes enable row level security;
alter table public.class_spots enable row level security;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Helper: is the current request a service-role call (bypasses RLS)?
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.is_service_role()
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select coalesce(auth.role(), '') = 'service_role';
$$;

revoke all on function public.is_service_role() from public;
revoke all on function public.is_service_role() from anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.is_service_role() to service_role;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- public.classes RLS
-- R1: signed-in users may read all classes (instructors are a subset of that).
-- R5: anonymous visitors get nothing.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create policy "classes_select_authenticated"
  on public.classes
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (true);

-- No insert/update/delete policies on classes => all writes are denied for
-- anon/authenticated. service_role bypasses RLS (R6).

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- public.class_spots RLS
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create policy "class_spots_select_authenticated"
  on public.class_spots
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    or exists (
      select 1 from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_spots.class_id
        and c.instructor_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

create policy "class_spots_insert_authenticated"
  on public.class_spots
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and status in ('enrolled', 'waitlisted')
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_id
        and c.instructor_id <> auth.uid()
        and (
          status = 'enrolled'
          and (select count(*) from public.class_spots s where s.class_id = c.id and s.status = 'enrolled') < c.capacity
        )
    )
  );

create policy "class_spots_update_authenticated"
  on public.class_spots
  for update
  to authenticated
  using (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and status = 'waitlisted'
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_id
        and c.instructor_id <> auth.uid()
        and (select count(*) from public.class_spots s where s.class_id = c.id and s.status = 'enrolled') < c.capacity
    )
  )
  with check (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and status = 'enrolled'
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_id
        and c.instructor_id <> auth.uid()
    )
  );

create policy "class_spots_delete_own"
  on public.class_spots
  for delete
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid());

create policy "class_spots_delete_instructor"
  on public.class_spots
  for delete
  to authenticated
  using (
    exists (
      select 1 from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_id
        and c.instructor_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- R3: nothing else about a spot can change; guard against field drift on
-- updates. Instructors do not appear in the UPDATE policy at all, so an
-- instructor cannot ever remove a spot via UPDATE (only via DELETE, R4).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.class_spots_guard_update()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if new.class_id is distinct from old.class_id
     or new.user_id is distinct from old.user_id
     or new.status is distinct from old.status then
    raise exception 'only status may change on a class_spots row';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.class_spots_guard_update() from public;
revoke all on function public.class_spots_guard_update() from anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.class_spots_guard_update() to service_role;

create trigger class_spots_guard_update
  before update on public.class_spots
  for each row execute function public.class_spots_guard_update();
